english.note: Use this colloquial choice when something is deliberately kept out of sight, including keeping feelings or thoughts to oneself.

exampleSentences.english: I don't want to dissemble by hiding my feelings.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我唔想收埋自己嘅感受。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sau1 maai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 gam2 sau6

english.note: Use this for the figurative sense of bottling up feelings or emotions rather than for literal liquids.

exampleSentences.english: They always bottle up their feelings and refuse to talk to anyone.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢成日收埋自己嘅情緒，唔肯同人講。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sau1 maai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 cing4 seoi5 m4 hang2 tung4 jan4 gong2

english.note: Choose 收埋 when the emphasis is on hiding something away, especially feelings, secrets, or something being concealed from view.

exampleSentences.english: I had to bury this sadness deep in my heart.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我將呢段傷心事收埋喺心底。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 ni1 dyun6 soeng1 sam1 si6 sau1 maai4 hai2 sam1 dai2
